gaps: Source gives no region names for the six shipwreck chests.
Source does not describe per-plan effects beyond the upgrade category named in each title.
notes: Six come from underwater shipwrecks (the article calls these the best upgrades) and six from treasure maps. All are spent in the Harbourmaster's Upgrade Ship menu; the Harbourmaster shop must first be upgraded at Great Inagua. Fully upgrading the ship unlocks the Ship This trophy/achievement. Source states full ship and Harbourmaster upgrades total 309,800 Reales, 4,755 Metal, 2,750 Wood, 550 Cloth (the upgrades page states 315,800 Reales including the Diving Bell). Nothing is missable.
